info.title: OCR + ID detection
info.description: Local, privacy-first text extraction (Arabic/English) and identity-document detection. All `/v1` endpoints need the `X-Api-Key` header. Every error has the shape `{"error": {"code", "message", "requestId"}}`; send `X-Request-Id` to correlate.

post.summary: Upload a document (PDF, DOCX, JPG, PNG, WEBP, TIFF) for text extraction + ID detection (async job)

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

schema.description: Retry-safe uploads: the same key returns the same job (within RESULT_TTL_S)
schema.title: Idempotency-Key

parameters.description: Retry-safe uploads: the same key returns the same job (within RESULT_TTL_S)

post.summary: Extract text only (no ID detection, no LLM) and return it in the response
post.description: Synchronous: the request waits for OCR (about 2-3 s per scanned page on CPU). Arabic, English and mixed documents. At most `EXTRACT_MAX_PAGES` pages; use `/v1/documents` for larger files. The file is processed in memory only.

post.summary: Experimental: read handwritten text (Arabic first, English too) and return it
post.description: Synchronous and slow (on CPU about a minute or more per page). Images (JPG, PNG, WEBP, TIFF) and PDFs, every page rendered; at most `HANDWRITING_MAX_PAGES` pages. One request at a time (503 `busy` otherwise). Pages without ink are skipped, not sent to the model. `confidence` is always null: the model gives no calibrated confidence. Separate from `/v1/extract`, and may change while it is evaluated. The file is processed in memory only.

post.summary: Experimental: extract text (printed and handwritten), correct it, flag what needs review and answer questions from the document (async job)
post.description: Every page is routed: text layers are taken as they are; scanned pages and images are read by PaddleOCR, and pages that are handwritten or mixed go to the handwriting model (the result's `pages[].route` says why, and `uncertain` when it is not clear). The local text LLM then corrects and formats the text without changing numbers, dates or IDs, lists what a person should review, and answers the `questions` from the document only, with page citations. Questions are optional: without them the job only extracts and corrects. Poll `GET /v1/jobs/{jobId}` (or use `callbackUrl`). Slow: handwriting takes about a minute or more per page on CPU. At most `ANSWER_MAX_PAGES` pages. Builds on the experimental handwriting model, so it may change while it is evaluated.

get.summary: Job status, and the result when done
get.description: With `wait=N` (seconds, at most MAX_WAIT_S) the request is held until the job is done or failed, or N seconds pass (long-polling: no client-side polling loop needed).

delete.summary: Delete a job and its result now

get.summary: Full status: 503 unless OCR models are present AND the text LLM is available
Liveness: the process is up (for restarts by an orchestrator)
Readiness: OCR models present and the job worker running (for load balancers). The LLM is reported but not required, because /v1/extract works without it.
Experimental: status of the handwriting model (enabled, installed, downloaded, loaded or reachable). Not part of /health or /health/ready

status.title: Status
status.description: not_found: the document doesn't contain it; unavailable: the text model could not be used

answer.title: Answer
answer.description: From the document only, in the question's language

needsReview.title: Needsreview
needsReview.description: A citation could not be verified, overlaps a review item or an uncertain page, the answer has no citation, or only part of the document was read

questions.title: Questions
questions.description: A question about the document; repeat the field for several (at most ANSWER_MAX_QUESTIONS)

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: auto (default): route each page; printed / handwritten: read every page with that engine (handwritten also renders PDF pages that have a text layer)

correct.title: Correct
correct.description: false: no LLM correction (extraction, routing and questions only)

original.title: Original
original.description: Words of the original text (empty: words were inserted)

corrected.title: Corrected
corrected.description: Words of the corrected text (empty: words were removed)

quote.title: Quote
quote.description: Supporting text, as quoted by the LLM

verified.title: Verified
verified.description: The quote was found on that page

status.title: Status
status.description: partial: some parts kept their original text (see review); skipped: correct=false

normalizedText.title: Normalizedtext
normalizedText.description: Arabic-normalized text, for search and matching

timingsMs.title: Timingsms
timingsMs.description: Milliseconds per stage, e.g. extract, ocr, llm, vision, total (ocrPages: number of OCR'd pages); keys depend on the stages run

ExtractResult.title: ExtractResult
ExtractResult.description: Text-only result. `languages` lists `ar`/`en` by amount of text.

mimeType.title: Mimetype
mimeType.description: Detected from the content (magic bytes), never from the name

name.title: Name
name.description: The model (Hugging Face id, local folder or served name)

device.title: Device
device.description: cpu / cuda for the transformers backend; null for openai

maxPixels.title: Maxpixels
maxPixels.description: Largest image size the model saw (pixels)

segmenter.title: Segmenter
segmenter.description: How pages were split for the model (whole_page in this version)

text.title: Text
text.description: As the model read it: only line endings and surrounding whitespace are tidied

confidence.title: Confidence
confidence.description: Always null: the model gives no calibrated confidence, and none is made up

skipped.title: Skipped
skipped.description: blank: the page has (almost) no ink, so it was not sent to the model

warnings.title: Warnings
warnings.description: truncated: the output hit HANDWRITING_MAX_NEW_TOKENS; repetition_loop: the output repeats itself (a decoding loop). Review such pages

fullText.title: Fulltext
fullText.description: All pages' text, blank pages left out

HandwritingResult.title: HandwritingResult
HandwritingResult.description: Experimental handwriting OCR result. `languages` lists `ar`/`en` by amount of text.

name.title: Name
name.description: The handwriting model (Hugging Face id, local folder or served name)

device.title: Device
device.description: cpu / cuda for the transformers backend; null for openai

decidedBy.title: Decidedby
decidedBy.description: The stages that took part, in order

mrz.description: Present when an MRZ with at most one failed check digit was found

code.title: Code
code.description: Stable error code (see the error table); program against it

correctedText.title: Correctedtext
correctedText.description: Extract-and-answer: all pages' corrected text; null when the text was not corrected

warnings.title: Warnings
warnings.description: context_truncated: the questions were answered from the first pages only

JobView.title: JobView
JobView.description:
`status` queued/processing/done/failed. When done, the result fields are included; when failed, `error`.
`webhook` is present when a callbackUrl was given. Jobs of POST /v1/extract-and-answer (experimental) also have
`correctedText`, `routing`, `review`, `correction`, and `answers` when questions were asked.

bbox.title: Bbox
bbox.description: [x0, y0, x1, y1] as fractions (0-1) of the page, origin top-left

checks.title: Checks
checks.description: ICAO check digit per field, e.g. documentNumber, birthDate, expiryDate, personalNumber, composite

namesSource.title: Namessource
namesSource.description: mrz+text: names were completed from the printed text

Mrz.title: Mrz
Mrz.description:
Parsed machine-readable zone. Personal data. Rely on a field only when its `checks` entry is true; names carry
no check digit.

method.title: Method
method.description: text_layer: taken from the PDF/DOCX; ocr: recognized

confidence.title: Confidence
confidence.description: Average OCR confidence 0-1; null for text_layer pages

width.title: Width
width.description: OCR pages with includeBoxes: pixel width of the OCR'd image

height.title: Height
height.description: OCR pages with includeBoxes: pixel height of the OCR'd image

lines.title: Lines
lines.description: OCR pages with includeBoxes: lines in reading order

engine.title: Engine
engine.description: Extract-and-answer: the engine whose reading is `text`

route.description: Extract-and-answer: how the page was routed, and why

readings.title: Readings
readings.description: Extract-and-answer: every engine's reading (mixed and uncertain pages have two)

correctedText.title: Correctedtext
correctedText.description: Extract-and-answer: the LLM's corrected, formatted text; null when not corrected

changes.title: Changes
changes.description: Extract-and-answer: word-level differences between text and correctedText, computed by the service (not reported by the LLM)

warnings.title: Warnings
warnings.description: Extract-and-answer: the handwriting model could not read the page

Page.title: Page
Page.description:
A page of the result. The fields from `engine` on are only in extract-and-answer results (experimental), where
`text` is the primary engine's reading.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: The processing profile (`default`: the global settings)

handwriting.description: Extract-and-answer: the handwriting model, when it read a page

routing.description: Extract-and-answer: the routing settings, when a page was routed

withheld.title: Withheld
withheld.description: Left out by the profile (data minimization): `text` = pages[].text, fullText, normalizedText and lines are empty and the AI models' reasons are removed; `mrz` = no idDetection.mrz. Withheld data is not stored either.

Processing.title: Processing
Processing.description:
What produced this result, for audits: the service version, the processing profile, and the OCR models, rules
file version (start of its SHA-256) and LLMs that were actually used. A part that wasn't used is left out.

confidence.title: Confidence
confidence.description: PaddleOCR's average confidence; always null for the handwriting model and text layers (no calibrated confidence exists)

quote.title: Quote
quote.description: The text concerned, as in the original; null for page-level items

suggestion.title: Suggestion
suggestion.description: A proposed reading (from the LLM), or null

source.title: Source
source.description: llm: flagged by the text model; the others are checks of the service itself

located.title: Located
located.description: The quote was found in the original page text (false: the LLM's quote doesn't match it); null without a quote

confidence.title: Confidence
confidence.description: PaddleOCR confidence of the line (ocr_confidence items)

ReviewItem.title: ReviewItem
ReviewItem.description: Something a person should check. Never a guess presented as fact: `suggestion` is only a proposal.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: unknown: unclear from PaddleOCR's signals and no vision verdict

decidedBy.title: Decidedby
decidedBy.description: override: the request's `mode`; fallback: ROUTING_UNCERTAIN_FALLBACK applied

uncertain.title: Uncertain
uncertain.description: The kind is not known: review the page; both readings may be kept

engines.title: Engines
engines.description: Engines whose readings were kept, the primary one first

reasons.title: Reasons
reasons.description: Short reasons (from the signals, or the vision model's own)

read.title: Read
read.description: Regions recognized with a score >= OCR_MIN_SCORE

meanConfidence.title: Meanconfidence
meanConfidence.description: Mean recognition confidence 0-1; null when nothing was read

lowConfidenceShare.title: Lowconfidenceshare
lowConfidenceShare.description: Share of read regions below ROUTING_LOW_LINE_CONF

inkRatio.title: Inkratio
inkRatio.description: Ink share of the page; only measured when no text was detected

RouteSignals.title: RouteSignals
RouteSignals.description: PaddleOCR's numbers for a scanned page or image (what the routing decided on).

RoutingUsed.title: RoutingUsed
RoutingUsed.description:
The routing settings of extract-and-answer (ROUTING_*). Starting values, not calibrated: see
eval/run_routing_eval.py.
